Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:10:1.hebrew: למיגבא ביה מיניה - קונה בה כנגד מעותיו, ואם בא לפרוע המעות לאחר זמן, לא יקבלם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:10:1.english: To collect with it from him - [The lender] acquires [a portion] in it corresponding to his money, and if [the borrower] comes to repay the money after the [due] time, [the lender] does not [have to] accept it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:10:2.hebrew: סוף סוף אסמכתא היא - דלא א"ל קני לגוביינא, אלא אם איני נותן לך מכאן ועד שלש שנים — הדר הויא לה אסמכתא, דכל דאי אסמכתא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:10:2.english: Ultimately, it is an asmakhta - For he did not say to him, "Acquire [it] for collection" [unconditionally], rather, "[Acquire it] if I do not give you [the money] from now until three years [have passed]" — it reverts to being an asmakhta, for every "if" is an asmakhta.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:11:1.english: But what is [the case of] Rav Pappa's apotiki - that regarding an asmakhta it should be an apotiki?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:11:2.hebrew: דא"ל לא יהא לך פרעון אלא מזה - אף בתוך שלש שנים, ואם אין אני נותן לך מגופה כנגד מעותיך עד שלש שנים, תהא כולה שלך. בהא אמר רב פפא דאע"ג דלא קניא למיהוי כוליה דידיה לאחר ג', אפותיקי הוי למגבי מיניה, דבלאו אסמכתא נמי שווייה אפותיקי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:11:2.english: Where he said to him, "You shall have no payment except from this" - Even within three years, "and if I do not give you from [the land] itself [an amount] corresponding to your money within three years, all of it shall be yours." In this [case], Rav Pappa said that even though [the lender] does not acquire it for all of it to become his after three [years], it is [nevertheless] an apotiki [designated repayment] to collect from it, for even without the asmakhta he designated it as an apotiki.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:12:1.english: [Will] you let me collect - Corresponding to my money, from the best of the best-quality [land] that you have.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:12:2.hebrew: בידקא - שטף נהר, שטפה לעידי עידית. וכשבא זה לגבות מן העידית כפי תנאו, אמר לו: לא תיגבי אלא מבינונית אחרת שיש לי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:12:2.english: Bidka - A river torrent; it flooded the best of the superior-quality [land]. And when this [buyer] came to collect from the superior-quality [land] in accordance with his stipulation, [the seller] said to him: You shall only collect from other medium-quality [land] that I have.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:14:1.english: When I said to you [that] I [would] - to collect from superior-quality [land].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:15:1.english: Collect from this wine - And he fixed a price [for the wine], and eventually it appreciated in value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:17:1.english: And the produce must be returned - After three [years], if the buyer consumed it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:17:2.hebrew: מחילה בטעות - כי האי דהמוכר סבר שהיא קנויה ללוקח, ומן הדין אוכל פירות, ומוחל על אכילתו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:17:2.english: Mistaken forgiveness - Such as this [case], where the seller thinks that it is acquired by the buyer and [that] by law he consumes the produce, and [thus] he forgives his consumption [of it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:1.english: [One who] sells the fruit of a palm tree - Before its fruits have formed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:2.hebrew: עד שלא באו לעולם יכול לחזור בו - אם בא לחזור בו קודם שחנטו פירותיו, חוזר; דאפילו למ"ד (יבמות דף צג.) אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם, הני מילי שבא לחזור אחר שבא לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:2.english: Until they have come into the world, he can retract - If he comes to retract before its fruits have formed, he [may] retract; for even according to the one who says (Yevamot 93a) [that] a person can transfer ownership of something that has not yet come into the world, that applies [only] when he comes to retract after it has come into the world.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:3.hebrew: משבאו לעולם אינו יכול לחזור בו - דקסבר אדם מקנה דבר שלא בא לעולם בשעת המכר, שיהיה המכר חל לכשיבא לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:3.english: Once they have come into the world, he cannot retract - For he holds [that] a person can transfer ownership of something that has not [yet] come into the world at the time of the sale, [so] that the sale will take effect when it comes into the world.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:18:4.english: Even once they have come, etc. - For a person cannot transfer ownership of something that has not come into the world.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:19:1.hebrew: לא מפקינן מיניה - שהרי כל זמן שלא חזר, מחל על אכילתו, ואע"פ שבטעות — שלא היה יודע שיוכל לחזור — מחילה היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:19:1.english: We do not take [it] from him - For as long as he did not retract, he waived [his rights to] his consumption [of the produce]; and even though [it was] in error — as he did not know that he could retract — it is [a valid] waiver.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:19:2.hebrew: הכא הלואה היא - ומיחזי כרבית, שמתחילה בהלואה בא לו, וכרבית קצוצה דמי. ואין אבק רבית בדבר הלואה אלא בדבר מכר, כגון המרבה בפירות דמתניתין (לעיל בבא מציעא ס:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:19:2.english: Here it is a loan - And it appears like interest, for it came to him initially through a loan, and it is like fixed interest. And [the category of] "dust of interest" [avak ribit] does not apply to a matter of a loan, but rather to a matter of a sale, such as one who increases [the payment] in produce [as taught] in the Mishnah (above, Bava Metzia 60b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:1:1.hebrew: ואיבעית אימא מתני' דא"ל מעכשיו קנה - אם לא אתן לך עד שלש שנים, דלאו אסמכתא היא, אלא קנין גמור היא, שע"מ מכר גמור החזיק בה מעכשיו בדמים הללו, ואזולי אוזיל גביה, וזה קיבל עליו שאם יחזיר לו מעותיו עד שלש שנים יקבלם. והפירות, לרבי יהודה לוקח אוכלן, ולרבנן משלשין אותן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:1:1.english: And if you wish, say [that] the Mishnah [refers to a case] where he said to him, "Acquire [it] from now" - if I do not give [repay] you within three years — for it is not an asmakhta, rather it is a complete acquisition, since he took possession of it from now on condition of a complete sale for this money, and he [the seller] lowered [the price] for him, and this one [the buyer] took upon himself that if he returns his money to him within three years, he will accept it. And [as for] the produce: according to Rabbi Yehudah, the buyer eats it, and according to the Rabbis, they deposit it with a third party.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:2:1.hebrew: בזמניה קניא - קס"ד הגיע זמן ולא נתן לו מעותיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:2:1.english: It effects acquisition at its [proper] time - It was initially assumed [that this means if] the time arrived and he did not give him his money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:2:2.english: Not at its time - Before [its time] arrived.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:4:1.english: He encountered him - The borrower [encountered the lender].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:4:2.hebrew: בגו זמניה - וא"ל קני, לא אפדנה עוד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:4:2.english: Within its time - And [the borrower] said to him, "Acquire [it], I will not redeem it again."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:4:3.hebrew: קני - דגמר ואקני, דאי לא, למה ליה למימר ליה? הלא אין יכול עכשיו לתובעו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:4:3.english: He acquires [it] - For he resolved and transferred ownership; for if not, why would he say [this] to him? Behold, he cannot demand [payment from] him now.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:5:1.english: He will not come to disturb me - And [he said this] merely to put [him] off, out of embarrassment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:6:1.english: He found him - On the due date.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:6:2.hebrew: דשתי שיכרא - בחנות, אין זה עצב לחזור אחר פדיון שדהו, ודעתו לשקעה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:6:2.english: That he was drinking beer - In a tavern; this [person] is not anxious to seek the redemption of his field, and his intention is to forfeit it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:7:1.hebrew: לפכוחי פחדיה - להפיג דאגתו שדואג על המעות, דכתיב (תהלים קד) ויין ישמח:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:7:1.english: To neutralize his fear - To dispel his worry, as he worries about the money, as it is written (Psalms 104): "And wine gladdens [the heart of man]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:7:2.english: If he is particular about the money - If he is particular when selling his possessions not to [sell for] less than their value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:7:3.english: [The lender] has certainly acquired [it] - [The borrower] is not concerned if his field is forfeited.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:8:1.hebrew: דלא תיתזיל ארעיה - שאם יראה אותו מחזר אחרי מעות ומוכר נכסיו בפחות, מוזיל קרקעותיו. ולעולם אנוס הוא, ולא גמר ומקני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:8:1.english: That his land not be depreciated - For if one sees him going around seeking money and selling his property for less [than its value], he lowers [the value of] his lands. And in truth, he is acting under compulsion and does not genuinely resolve to transfer ownership.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 66b:8:2.english: He is particular about land - That he will not sell any land, even for its value.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:10:1.hebrew: ואי אמר קני לגוביינא מי קני הא אסמכתא היא - וא״ת, והא משמע בסוף פירקין (בבא מציעא דף עג:) דלא הוי אסמכתא אלא היכא דאין בידו אע״ג דלא גזים — כי ההוא דיהיב זוזי לחבריה למזבין ליה חמרא ופשע ולא זבין ליה, או היכא דגזים אע״ג דבידו — כי ההיא ד"אם אוביר ולא אעביד אשלם אלפא זוזי", אבל "אם אוביר ולא אעביד אשלם במיטבא" (שם.) דלא גזים ובידו, לא חשיבא אסמכתא; והכא מאי אסמכתא איכא אם נותן לו קרקע בחובו? וי״ל דחשיב כמו גזים, לפי שאין אדם רגיל למכור קרקעותיו כלל. ובסמוך גבי חמרא, דאמר "כל דאי לא קני" אע״ג דחמרא למכירה קאי, התם נמי כמו גזים חשיב, לפי שעדיין לא היה זמן מכר היין, ונותנו עתה בזול:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:10:1.english: And if he said, "Acquire [it] for collection," does he acquire [it]? Behold, it is an asmakhta - And if you will ask: Does it not emerge at the end of our chapter (Bava Metzia 73b) that it is only an asmakhta where it is not in his power [to fulfill the condition], even though he did not exaggerate — like that [case] of one who gave money to his fellow to buy wine for him, and [the agent] was negligent and did not buy [it] for him; or where he exaggerated, even though it is in his power — like that [clause], "If I leave [the field] fallow and do not work [it], I will pay a thousand zuz"; whereas [in the clause], "If I leave [it] fallow and do not work [it], I will pay with the best [produce]" (ibid.), where he did not exaggerate and it is in his power, it is not considered an asmakhta? And here, what asmakhta is there if he gives him land for his debt? And one can say that it is considered like exaggerating, because a person is not accustomed to sell his land at all. And shortly below regarding wine, where [the Gemara] says, "Any 'if' does not acquire," even though wine is meant for sale, there too it is considered like exaggerating, because it was not yet the time for selling wine, and he is giving it now cheaply.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:19:1.hebrew: התם זביני הכא הלואה - פירוש בקונטרס: הכא הלואה, ומתחזי כרבית שמתחילה בהלואה בא לידו וכריבית קצוצה דמי, ואין אבק רבית בדבר הלואה אלא בדבר מכר, כגון המרבה בפירות דמתניתין. וקשה: דאם כן פליג רב נחמן אדרבינא, דאמר בריש פירקין (בבא מציעא דף סב.): "משכנתא בלא נכייתא — בדינינו אין מחזירין". ועוד: דאמר לקמן בשמעתין: "משכנתא באתרא דמסלקי, אכל טפי — לא מפקינן מיניה", ומשמע דליכא מאן דפליג. ועוד: דמשמע לפירוש הקונטרס דבמסקנא לרב נחמן מחילה בטעות הויא מחילה, בר מהלואה משום דמיחזי כרבית; ובכל דוכתין משמע דמחילה בטעות לא הויא מחילה לרב נחמן: בחזקת הבתים (ב״ב דף מא. ושם ד״ה אמר), גבי רב ענן דשקיל בידקא בארעיה, א״ל: "מחילה בטעות הויא"; ולעיל בריש המפקיד (בבא מציעא דף לה.), גבי ההוא דאפקיד כיפי, דאמר: "שומא בטעות הואי"; ותני נמי (נזיר דף לא.): "ב״ה אומרים: הקדש טעות אינו הקדש"; ובספ״ק דגיטין (דף יד.) אמרינן: "כל קנין בטעות חוזר". ומפר״ת: הכא הלואה — דהלוה לא הקנה אלא בתורת מכר, והמכר אינו כלום דאסמכתא לא קניא, נמצא דהוי מחילה בטעות ולא הוי מחילה, ולכך הדרי פירי; אבל אם היה נותנו בתורת רבית — לא הוי הדרי, דאבק רבית הוא. אבל התם, גבי פירות דקל, זביני, ולא מחילה בטעות היא — דנהי דיכול לחזור, מ״מ אין לו לחזור כי היכי דליקו בהימנותיה, ולכך אית לן למימר דאפילו היה יודע שיכול לחזור לא היה חוזר. ורבא, דהוה בעי לאותביה מאונאה, היה סבור דטעמא דרב נחמן דלא מפקינן באי שמיט ואכיל משום דמחילה בטעות הויא מחילה; ולפי סברת רבא היה משיבו ומביא ראיה מאיילונית:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:19:1.english: There, [it is] a sale; here, [it is] a loan - Rashi explains [lit. in the Kuntres]: Here [it is] a loan, and it appears like interest, since it initially came into his possession through a loan, and it is like fixed interest [ribbit ketzutzah]; and there is no [category of] secondary interest [avak ribbit] in a matter of a loan, rather [only] in a matter of a sale, such as one who increases [the price] in produce in our Mishnah. And this is difficult: For if so, Rav Nachman disagrees with Ravina, who says at the beginning of our chapter (Bava Metzia 62a): "[Regarding] a collateralized property [mashkanta] without deduction — in our courts we do not return [the produce]." And furthermore: For [the Gemara] says later in our sugya: "[Regarding] a mashkanta in a place where they can evict [the lender by repaying], if he consumed more — we do not extract [it] from him," and it is implied that there is no one who disagrees. And furthermore: For it is implied according to Rashi's explanation that in the conclusion, according to Rav Nachman, a waiver in error is [a valid] waiver, except in [the case of] a loan because it appears like interest; yet in all places it is implied that a waiver in error is not [a valid] waiver according to Rav Nachman: in [the chapter] Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 41a, and there s.v. Amar), regarding Rav Anan, where a breach swept through his land, [Rav Nachman] said to him: "It is a waiver in error"; and earlier at the beginning of [the chapter] HaMafkid (Bava Metzia 35a), regarding that man who deposited jewels [kifei], where [Rav Nachman] said: "It was an appraisal in error"; and it is also taught [in a Mishnah] (Nazir 31a): "Beit Hillel say: A consecration in error is not consecrated"; and at the end of the first chapter of Gittin (14a), we say: "Any acquisition in error reverts." And Rabbeinu Tam explains: Here [it is] a loan — for the borrower only transferred ownership as a sale, and the sale is nothing because an asmakhta [a conditional commitment] does not acquire; thus it turns out that it is a waiver in error, and it is not a [valid] waiver, and therefore the produce is returned. However, if he had given it to him as interest, it would not be returned, for it is [only] avak ribbit. But there, regarding the produce of a palm tree, [it is] a sale, and it is not a waiver in error — for although he can retract, nevertheless he ought not to retract so that he may stand by his word, and therefore we must say that even if he had known that he could retract, he would not have retracted. And Rava, who sought to challenge [Rav Nachman] from [the law of] ona'ah [overcharging], thought that Rav Nachman's reason that we do not extract [the produce] when [the buyer] seizes and consumes [it] is because a waiver in error is [a valid] waiver; and according to Rava's understanding, [the Gemara] was answering him and bringing a proof from an aylonit [a barren woman].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:7:1.hebrew: אי קפיד בדמי קני - פי' בקונטרס: אם מקפיד במכירת חפציו שלא לפחות משויו, קנה. קשה: דא"כ הל"ל "דלא ליתזלו מטלטלין", ואמאי קאמר "דלא ליתזל ארעיה"? ועוד: דהא דמקפיד למכרן בפחות משויין — דלמא משום דידע דאסמכתא לא קניא? אע"ג דאית ליה לאהדורי אזוזי אי לא אסמכוה, היינו משום דליקו בהימנותיה, אבל למכור בפחות — לא! וכן מה שפירש: "אי קפיד בארעא" — למוכרה אפי' בשוויה — ודאי קני, ואמאי? דלמא קפיד משום דאסמכתא לא קניא! ונראה לפרש: "אי קפיד בדמי" — שהקפיד בשעת הלואה ליקח עליה שוויה בזה התנאי, א"כ דעתו היה לשקעה ביד המלוה. ופריך: דלמא "כי היכי דלא ליתזל ארעיה" — אינו רוצה לעשות שום תנאי שיש בו זלזול! אלא "אי קפיד בארעא" — שאינו רוצה לעשות תנאי זה בשום קרקע אלא בזו, א"כ אין בדעתו לפדותה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 66b:7:1.english: If he is particular about the money, [the lender] has acquired [the field] - Rashi explained [that this means] if he is particular when selling his possessions not to accept less than their value, [the lender] has acquired [the field]. [This is] difficult: for if so, [the Gemara] should have said, "so that his movable property not be depreciated," and why does it say, "so that his land not be depreciated"? And furthermore: as for [the fact] that he is particular [not] to sell them for less than their value — perhaps [it is] because he knows that an asmakhta does not effect acquisition! Even though he must search for money if no one else promised him [money], that is so that he will stand by his word, whereas to sell for less [than their value] — [he would] not [do that]! And similarly, that which [Rashi] explained [regarding] "if he is particular about the land" — [meaning he refuses] to sell it even at its full value — [that the lender] certainly acquires [it]: why [so]? Perhaps he is particular [not to sell it] because [he knows] that an asmakhta does not effect acquisition! Rather, it appears [more] plausible to explain: "If he is particular about the money" — that he was particular at the time of the loan to take [a loan equal to] its full value upon it with this condition, if so, his intention was to forfeit it into the hand of the lender. And [Rav Aḥa] objects: Perhaps "in order that his land not be depreciated" — he does not want to make any condition that involves a depreciation [of its value]! Rather, "if he is particular about the land" — that he does not want to make this condition on any [other] land, only on this one — if so, he has no intention of redeeming it.
